scripts.dev: if [ -f .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000; else python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000; fi
scripts.lint: if [ -f .venv/bin/ruff ]; then .venv/bin/ruff check .; elif command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff check .; else echo 'Ruff not found, skipping'; fi
scripts.lint:fix: if [ -f .venv/bin/ruff ]; then .venv/bin/ruff check . --fix; elif command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff check . --fix; else echo 'Ruff not found, skipping'; fi
scripts.test: if [ -f .venv/bin/pytest ]; then .venv/bin/pytest; elif command -v pytest >/dev/null 2>&1; then pytest; else echo 'Pytest not found, skipping'; fi
scripts.test:ci: if [ -f .venv/bin/pytest ]; then .venv/bin/pytest --tb=short -q; elif command -v pytest >/dev/null 2>&1; then pytest --tb=short -q; else echo 'Pytest not found, skipping'; fi
scripts.build: echo 'No build step for Python service'
